title: Package eve 0.3.0 release artifacts
summary: Prepared the next npm/GitHub release by adding macOS approval app packaging to the tag workflow and marking the accumulated changes as 0.3.0 in the changelog.
userVisibleChange: npx @nhestrompia/eve@latest install can install the current release, including the macOS approval app asset expected by the installer.

risks.title: GitHub Actions macOS runner availability can block tagged release publication

decisions.title: Build and zip eve.app on macos-latest during tagged releases
Keep npm package.json at development version locally and let the release workflow set the tag version before publish

validation.output: Go tests, CLI version injection test, npm installer tests, npm package dry-run, UI tests, UI production build, macOS approval app tests, and macOS approval app Release build all passed.
